name: termina
description: Hybrid terminal/editor: prompt an agentic coding agent in a terminal, watch it edit files live in a Monaco (VS Code) editor, click modified files to inspect them.

scripts.test:release-macos: pnpm run test:sandbox-security-live && pnpm run test:e2e-release-smoke
scripts.test:release: pnpm run test && pnpm run test:release-core && pnpm run test:agent-core-main && pnpm run test:release-workflow
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.test:spikes: pnpm run spike -- capture && pnpm run spike -- merge && pnpm run spike -- platform && pnpm run spike -- tree-delta && pnpm run spike -- gitignore && pnpm run spike -- terminal-roster && pnpm run spike -- core-session-promotion && pnpm run spike -- promotion-transaction && pnpm run spike -- watcher-idle && pnpm run test:promotion-native-boundary
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/prepare-resources.ts && electron-builder
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm run build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/prepare-resources.ts && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/prepare-resources.ts && electron-builder --mac
